title: Lossy dielectric slab in WR-90: εr = 2.2, tan δ = 0.02, 20 mm
source: TE10 transmission-line cascade with the complex propagation constant β = √(k0² εr(1 − j tan δ) − (π/a)²) in the slab (D. M. Pozar, Microwave Engineering, 4th ed., Wiley 2012, §3.3 and §4.4), evaluated by ABCD matrices

quantities.reason: second-order elements of 3 mm (as for the lossless dielectric step, error about 1e-3 dB)
measured 1.8e-3 (at 12 GHz, ten elements per guide wavelength in the slab): the same discretisation error as the lossless cases, the loss term being exact in the element mass matrix
